answer.text: Allow participants to hedge/speculate on commodity price movements

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook states that commodity derivatives allow participants to trade contracts based on commodities, hedge price fluctuations, and speculate on price movements, which is what the keyed option captures. The Trap: "Only for farmers" ignores institutional, trader, and PMS-side participation. "Unregulated" contradicts the SEBI-regulated framework set out in the source. "Settle in equity" mis-states how commodity contracts are settled. Note: Only the hedge/speculate rationale and the SEBI-regulated, PMS-permitted (with client consent) framing are anchored to the cited pages; any specific merger history or commodity-PMS-IA characterisation requires a separately cited source.
